A Letter For You

My love,

Four years ago, my life quietly turned into my favourite story, and you have been its best part ever since. Thank you for every laugh, every hug, every patient day, and for choosing me again and again.

With you, even ordinary moments feel special. You are my calm, my comfort and my happiest place. I love you more than I can ever say in words.

Happy 4th Anniversary. Here's to forever, and to all the days we haven't counted yet.

Yours, always ♥
